title: Return of the SSS-Class Ranker
altTitles: The King of Violence Has Returned
The King of Violence Has Returned
description: Rokan was the King of Violence and the strongest player in the virtual reality game The Lord. After an enemy guild's assassination order causes him to lose everything, he unexpectedly returns three years into the past. With his memories, knowledge of the future, and unparalleled control skills intact, Rokan begins his second chance by rebuilding his strength, taking revenge on those who betrayed him, and climbing back to the top of The Lord.
author: Gald / HoJun
